name: Smuggler's Paradise
summary: At Powderfuse Port, Friz Frazzlespark sends you after Eastsea pirates who took his stolen goods. He calls it your first lesson in dealing with backstabbers.

sections.title: Friz's Lesson
sections.body: Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port wants you to reclaim goods taken by Eastsea pirates. He says he stole them first, and calls taking them back your first lesson as his lackey.

sections.title: A First Lesson
sections.body: Friz says you have learned your first lesson well. He offers his wisdom without charge, then points you toward another assignment.

faq.answer: Friz Frazzlespark is the goblin who asks you to reclaim his stolen goods from Eastsea pirates.

faq.q: What did the Eastsea pirates take?
faq.answer: The Eastsea pirates took a shipment of goods that Friz says he had stolen first.

faq.q: Where does Friz want the goods returned?
faq.answer: Friz asks you to collect the goods for him at Powderfuse Port.

faq.q: Why does Friz want the goods back?
faq.answer: Friz says the pirates took goods he had stolen first, and calls taking them back a lesson in dealing with backstabbers.
